quiz.question_id: Kapan file atau direktori dimasukkan ke dalam binary saat memakai package `embed`?
quiz.question_en: When are files or directories placed into the binary when using the `embed` package?

quiz.question_id: Directive mana yang benar untuk menyematkan file ke binary Go?
quiz.question_en: Which directive is correct for embedding a file into a Go binary?

quiz.question_id: Tipe variabel mana yang digunakan lesson untuk menyematkan direktori lengkap?
quiz.question_en: Which variable type does the lesson use to embed a complete directory?

quiz.question_id: Mengapa package `embed` mendukung distribusi sebagai single binary?
quiz.question_en: Why does the `embed` package support single-binary distribution?
options_id: Karena asset ikut disematkan ke binary saat build sehingga tidak perlu file eksternal terpisah
Karena semua file otomatis dikompres menjadi nol byte
Karena asset akan diunduh dari internet saat runtime
options_en: Because assets are embedded into the binary at build time so separate external files are not required
Because every file is automatically compressed to zero bytes
Because assets are downloaded from the internet at runtime

quiz.question_id: Mengapa contoh HTTP static file memakai `fs.Sub(webDist, "web/dist")` sebelum `http.FileServer`?
quiz.question_en: Why does the static-file HTTP example use `fs.Sub(webDist, "web/dist")` before `http.FileServer`?
options_id: Untuk membuat sub-filesystem yang berakar di direktori asset yang ingin diserve
options_en: To create a sub-filesystem rooted at the asset directory you want to serve

quiz.question_id: Pasangan API mana yang tepat untuk membaca dan menelusuri isi embedded filesystem pada lesson?
quiz.question_en: Which API pair is appropriate for reading and traversing an embedded filesystem in the lesson?
What is the role of `http.FS(dist)` in the `http.FileServer` example?
options_id: Mengadaptasi filesystem menjadi bentuk yang bisa dipakai `http.FileServer`
options_en: It adapts the filesystem into a form `http.FileServer` can use
It stores files to temporary disk
It turns the handler into middleware
It creates a new API route

quiz.question_id: Pattern mana yang menunjukkan penyematan beberapa file HTML dari dua lokasi sekaligus?
quiz.question_en: Which pattern shows embedding multiple HTML files from two locations at once?

quiz.question_id: Menurut catatan lesson, file dengan awalan `.` atau `_` akan bagaimana secara default?
quiz.question_en: According to the lesson note, what happens by default to files whose names start with `.` or `_`?
options_id: Mereka tidak di-embed kecuali menggunakan prefix `all:`
options_en: They are not embedded unless you use the `all:` prefix
They can only be embedded as `[]byte`
They are automatically removed from the binary

quiz.question_en: When is the `all:` prefix in `//go:embed all:web/dist` needed?
options_id: Saat Anda juga ingin menyertakan file yang default-nya diabaikan seperti yang berawalan `.` atau `_`
Saat ingin compile hanya di Linux
Saat ingin file bisa dimodifikasi saat runtime
options_en: When you also want to include files that are ignored by default, such as those starting with `.` or `_`
When you only want to compile on Linux
When you want files to be modifiable at runtime
